class.name: OcgGeomVectorwithmagnitude
class.brief_description: Defines a vector with magnitude. A vector with magnitude can have a zero length.
class.description: ! Defines a vector with magnitude. ! A vector with magnitude can have a zero length.

method.name: from_gp_Vec_const_ref
method.description: Creates a transient copy of V.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt_const_ref_gp_Pnt_const_ref
method.description: Creates a vector from the point P1 to the point P2. The magnitude of the vector is the distance between P1 and P2

method.name: from_double_double_double
method.description: Creates a vector with three cartesian coordinates.

method.name: SetCoord
method.description: Assigns the values X, Y and Z to the coordinates of this vector.

method.name: SetVec
method.description: Converts the gp_Vec vector V into this vector.

method.name: Multiply
method.description: Computes the product of the vector <me> by a scalar.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this vector.
